records.original_body:
## Scope: research only, zero product changes

Original 2022 Khamitova et al. [Springer original abstract](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00217-022-03960-w), independent first-party [University of Camerino record](https://pubblicazioni.unicam.it/handle/11581/456172): two baskets, four shower/distribution disc heights 4–7 mm, Arabica/Robusta at 12/14 g and 40 mL output. Reported cup polysaccharide variation **does not show** a universal preferred hardware/dose or personalized five-taste optimum. Full original methods/PDF/raw data unavailable; accurately flagged.

- Parent development `817a7574fd09eb08251dec9da3a19629db62e7fe`, proposed HEAD `b909b5b654cfd4c852661db5c538c79e480bb8b6`, verified actual parent-tree compare **exactly three doc files**, no other files removed.
- Same-commit evidence: `docs/audits/issue455-research-source-coverage-20261103.json` 72 curated/177 evidence/92 proposals; `docs/workstreams/issue-455.md`; `docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md`.
- No code, tests, Locked policy, approval matrix/source register or release queue changes. No owner product approval required for no-op evidence boundary. #267 V2 direct-line audit receives zero credit. Standalone S019 PDF inaccessible; not reviewed.
- CI and merges are **pending** until exact head checks. Use the docs-only risk gate, skip unnecessary unrelated builds. No Netlify deployment/production SQL/Auth/Edge/member/provider writes or public-visibility changes.
records.semantic_disposition: Historical publisher abstract and independent university metadata described a constrained 2-basket/4-disc-height/Arabica-Robusta carbohydrate cup study. Full PDF/methods/raw data not read; no universal basket/dose/taste optimum and no current product policy update. Research/source owner #455.
